paraphrase: Every nonempty one-world local structure with a well-founded grounding relation, distinct existent grounding endpoints, and an independently specified noninitial-causing principle admits a two-world, universally accessible rigid-tag duplication that preserves the stated constraints in each world but has no de re necessarily existing concrete individual evaluated at the designated actual world (tag false; the other world is symmetric but is not separately stated in the type). The quantified claim establishes a general family of formal countermodels to those world-local conditions alone; it does not establish that any particular duplicated configuration is metaphysically possible or that no independent modal principle can entail a necessary being.
